- Findings to fix (agreed plan, 12-item todo):
  1. Time-decay is dead — `PET_EVT_TIME_TICK` never sent; attributes never change. Solution: dedicated 60 s `lv_timer` inside dm_pet.c (`PET_TIME_TICK_MS`) driving `pet_update_attrs_tick()`.
  2. Sleep deadlock — SLEEP state has no wake path. Wake when hour ∈ [6,22) && energy ≥ 30 (`PET_WAKE_ENERGY_MIN`).

Music hooks: `deskmate_ui.c music_resume()` (2704, sets `music_playing=true` at 2706) and `music_pause()` (2745, false at 2747).
